title: RobotCommand
description: A spoken robot command attributed to a face, with Hydrogen pointing result and command-hook status.

command_id.description: Unique identifier for this robot command event.

face_id.description: ID of the face that spoke the command.

text.description: Spoken command text (e.g. 'Hand me the bottle').

target_face_id.description: ID of the active target face at the time the command was issued.

point.description: Hydrogen Robotics ER pointing coordinate [y, x] normalized to [0, 1000], or null if blocked or no object matched.

object_label.description: Label of the pointed object, or null if blocked or not found.

allowed.description: Whether gate_command.py permitted robot_act to execute (true only when face_id === target_face_id).

hook_reason.description: Human-readable reason from gate_command.py when allowed is false (or approval note).

latency_ms.description: End-to-end latency in milliseconds for pointing and hook evaluation.

time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the command was processed.
